defs.def: to travel on water using sails or an engine 船或船上的人

ex.s: As soon as she graduated from high school she left home to live on Catalina Island off the Californian coast, away from her parents, where she enjoyed a life of sailing and off-road biking.
ex.t: 她一从高中毕业就离开家，住到加州海岸外的卡塔利娜岛上，远离父母，享受航海和越野骑行的人生。

defs.def: to control or travel on a boat with a sail, especially as a sport 驾驶（或乘坐）帆船航行（尤指作为体育运动）

ex.s: They travelled over snow-covered mountains and sailed hundreds of miles up icy rivers.
ex.t: 他们翻越被雪覆盖的群山，沿冰封的河流航行了数百英里。

ex.s: Match the routes to the explorers.] (1 Ferdinand Magellan (1480-1521) was a Portuguese explorer who sailed west from Spain across the Atlantic and Pacific oceans in search of a westward route to the Spice Islands (now part of Indonesia).
ex.t: 将路线与探险家匹配。费迪南德·麦哲伦（1480-1521）是一位葡萄牙探险家，他从西班牙向西横渡大西洋和太平洋，寻找前往香料群岛（现属印度尼西亚）的西行路线。

ex.s: Once there, Shackleton realised that their only hope was to sail back to South Georgia.
ex.t: 到达那里后，沙克尔顿意识到他们唯一的希望是航行回到南乔治亚岛。

defs.def: to begin a journey on water 船只或船上的人
to move quickly and smoothly in a particular direction; (of people) to move in a confident manner 掠；飘；浮游；（人）昂首而行，气宇轩昂地走
a sheet of strong cloth which the wind blows against to make a boat or ship travel through the water 帆
a trip in a boat or ship 乘船航行

ex.s: With no other alternative, Shackleton and five other men set sail in a small boat across the Weddell Sea.
ex.t: 在没有其他选择的情况下，沙克尔顿和另外五个人乘坐小船驶过韦德尔海。

defs.def: a set of boards attached to the arm of a windmill （风车的）翼板

ex.s: She almost looks as though she is about to set sail once again!
ex.t: 她看起来好像又要启航了
